native_gauge: Reference30 delivered crop; add(50,34) for native reference active coordinates.
vendor_gauge: Each vendor's own complete output; reference and internal alignment not equated to native reference30.
mapping_method: Manual corresponding-feature locations from the three complete views displayed at1920x1280. Nominal thumbnail-coordinate conversion uses output extents7032/6932 in x and4688/4620 in y, with small visually chosen center offsets. No numerical registration or reconstruction fit. B/C share the visually matching crop centers, not an asserted identical geometry.
scale_limit: The dimension ratios are display-coordinate conversions, not measured physical magnification. Actual local physical scale/correspondence errors remain unmeasured.384vendor pixels need not cover exactly the same physical width as384native pixels; no equal-footprint resolution metric is admissible.
display: Unmodified RGB16 subarrays and original ICC; PNG (RGB16+128)//257. No resampling, retone, gain, filtering or rotation.
